title: Make release sync refuse hosts listed in missing_targets
goal: Prevent the Core release updater from building or installing a release whose committed missing_targets record names the current native host.

results.root_cause: The existing updater used reference asset presence and a knowingly-allowed override, while the release record's missing_targets field is the authoritative host exclusion.
results.change: The updater derives the native rustc target, parses only missing_targets, skips an unqualified automatic tag, and refuses an explicit unqualified tag. The escape hatch is removed. The installer contract proves neither path builds or installs.
results.verification: bash -n scripts/susi-release-sync.sh; cargo fmt --all --check; git diff --check; cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test installer_contract: 9 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored.
results.boundary: Core release updater and installer contract only; no Commercial source, dependency, production secret, Windows run, or release tag.
